messages:
ana (Marketing): Quick sync — we're targeting a soft announcement for the Dedicated release tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Need final changelog, docs links, and a webinar slot by EOD today.
ben (Engineering): Copy. Changelog draft is ready, want me to paste the top-line bullets here?
ana (Marketing): Please. keep it high level — perf gains, routing/fallbacks, and Dedicated autopilot. also any breaking changes.
sasha (Product): Webinar: can we get a 30–40min slot that demo's the new routing and cost controls? Prefer 11:00 PT to hit APAC + US.
emily (Growth): 11:00 PT works for webinar. We'll slot customer-facing invite and registration. Need a 1-slide bench narrative summary.
ben (Engineering): Changelog bullets: 
- Improved KV-cache reuse, ~18% median token cost reduction for chat workloads
- Smart routing fallback to smaller model variants when capacity constrained
- New canary gating flag: `routing.canary_percent`
- No breaking API changes; some model names deprecated (mapping in docs)
liam (Docs): Paste please — I'll add final links and publish. Do we have the model name mapping?
ben (Engineering): mapping snippet: 
```
old_model_name -> rwdl-v1-small
old_large -> rwdl-v1-compat
```
liam (Docs): Great, I'll add to the migration section and include a code example. Link will be: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/dedicated-v0.9.3 (will be live after I publish)
ana (Marketing): For the benchmark narrative: Emily — can you draft 3 bullets that distill the 18% cost drop into customer-impact language? I'll use it for the email subject + webinar blurb.
emily (Growth): Sure. Draft: 
1) Up to 18% lower inference cost for chat apps using prefix caching.
2) Predictable latency with smart routing — fewer tail spikes in multi-tenant workloads.
3) Easier migration: automated model mapping and docs to avoid integration work.
ben (Engineering): Regarding rollout timing: we'll do a staged rollout w/ canary at 5% for 2 hours, then 25% for 4 hours, then full. If any error rate >1.5% or latency p95 regression >30% we rollback.
sasha (Product): Agree on gating thresholds. Add a safety window: do not promote canary during peak support hours (15:00-18:00 PT).
ana (Marketing): Docs links + changelog need to be published by 18:00 PT or we delay the announcement. Liam can you publish by then?
liam (Docs): I'll aim for 17:30 PT and post the final link here when done.
ben (Engineering): I'll wire the `routing.canary_percent` flag and post the deploy plan. (will tag deploy-bot)
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: dedicated-v0.9.3 canary @2323030000 (placeholder).
ana (Marketing): Perfect. Last items: social copy + one customer quote (if we can get one). Emily — follow up with sales for an early beta quote, please.
emily (Growth): On it, pinging sales now.
ana (Marketing): OK team — publishing checklist for the thread: 1) Changelog posted, 2) Docs live, 3) Webinar slot confirmed, 4) Bench bullets + social copy, 5) Deploy plan + canary gates. Post back here as each item completes. :thumbsup:
